items.label: Who and which coupon
items.message: IM7-3PB-L1, three-point bending; a new coupon: its folder and case page are written when it runs

items.label: Units consistent
items.message: every row in mm, MPa and N; the model is written in mm-MPa and forces come out in N

items.label: Geometry defined
items.message: 60 by 13 mm, 48 mm span with 6 mm overhangs, a node row on each support and nose line

items.label: Material defined
items.message: IM7-8552: library im7-8552 / ncamp-im7-8552-2019-rtd-measured-v1 (record 2026-10-10.1; Hexcel 8552 IM7 unidirectional prepreg 190 gsm 35% RC · qualification material property data report · CAM-RP-2009-015 · Rev B · Wichita State University · NIAR / NCAMP · 2019-04-16); rights class open-publisher; strengths given

items.label: Laminate assigned
items.message: 8 plies [45/0/-45/90]s, 1.46304 mm thick; the flat shell kernel solves the bending

items.label: Constraints defined
items.message: both support lines held along z (7 and 7 nodes); the centre node of each pins the in-plane motion without restraining the coupon's stretch or contraction; no rigid-body motion is left

items.label: Load applied
items.message: the loading nose (Nose) moved 1 mm down onto the coupon along z; the supports carry the reaction

items.label: Mesh quality acceptable
items.message: 180 elements, 217 nodes (structured mesh, order 1); aspect ratio 1.08 at worst (warns above 10); smallest angle 90° at worst (warns below 10°); largest angle 90° at worst (warns above 160°); Jacobian ratio 1 at worst (warns below 0.1)

items.label: Result points inside the coupon
items.message: results are read at node quarter at (6.5, 18), element centre, element quarter (mm)

items.label: Reference solver installed
items.message: CalculiX 2.22 at C:\Tools\PrePoMax v2.6.0\Solver\ccx_dynamic.exe: the reference solver that checks our engine's result

items.label: Document builder installed
items.message: Tectonic at C:\Users\erikv\AppData\Local\Programs\tectonic\tectonic.EXE: the package gets its PDF
